# sql.js runtime

`sql-wasm.js` and `sql-wasm.wasm` are the unmodified sql.js WebAssembly build from the official project's `gh-pages` commit `a186efdde18f1cb78032728f0dd8bf82363b9553`; they report SQLite 3.54.1. Git blob hashes are `44214b401262c2683602e39b8c97fb1263f6c7db` and `f50febf8ae2e79bd1a126b9be1330104b090cab3`, respectively. They are distributed under the adjacent MIT license.

Source: https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js/tree/a186efdde18f1cb78032728f0dd8bf82363b9553/dist
